messages: #p506# of #m10004000# says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...

I met #p506# in #m10004000#. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the #o6#s that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of #o6#s, Ayan can't take a single step out of #m10004000#, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary?
I took out #o6#s for #p506#'s sake in #m10004000#. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
name: The Stump Horror Story
